items.question: Tell me the deadline for the PS-17 generator hookup.
items.text:

items.question: What does '2 teams sign' mean?
items.text: "2 teams sign" means a decision is Tier 3: two approvers from two different teams must both sign before it goes ahead. The person who proposed the decision can't be one of the signers, so a second pair of eyes always checks it. You'll see these on the Decisions page, where each waiting decision shows who must sign and its decide-by time. The button below opens that page.

items.question: Was bedeutet ETR?
items.text: ETR bedeutet vermutlich „Estimated Time of Restoration“, also die geschätzte Zeit, bis der Strom wieder da ist. Diese ausgeschriebene Form steht allerdings nicht in den Plattformdaten. Dort finde ich nur verwandte Begriffe: „Global ETR“ ist der Zeitpunkt, an dem 90 % der Kunden, die zum Höhepunkt ohne Strom waren, wieder Strom haben (zur Veröffentlichung müssen Command und Operations unterschreiben). „ETR accuracy“ zeigt, wie weit jede Schätzung von dem entfernt war, was passiert ist; der Istwert ist simuliert, also ist das Übung und kein Feldnachweis. Der Button unten öffnet die After-action-Seite mit dem Tab „ETR accuracy“.

items.text: The Network map feed (gis-trace) is flagged stale: its product age is 1,590 min against a freshness limit of 1,440 min. The documents don't say whether this affects the forecast. The outage reports, smart meters and grid sensors feeds are not stale, and the surge signals come from public EAGLE-I data, not gis-trace. Treat the surge signals in Long, McIntosh, Tattnall, Tift and Glynn counties as signals to check, with caution.

items.question: Where can I check which deadlines were met or missed?
items.text: The After-action page is the place for this. Its Deadlines tab shows which decisions were approved by their decide-by time (met) and which were approved late or never (missed). If you want to see a single decision and what became of it, the Decisions page opens each one on its own page, and the buttons below open both pages.
